observedProduction.stationSubscriptionModel: station_subscriptions holds current plan_id, starts_at, current_period_end, status; no scheduled_next_plan, effective_start or change-requests table
observedProduction.activeSwitchApi: station_select_saas_plan rejects any trialing/active/grace/overdue subscription with INVALID_REQUEST
observedProduction.ownerUi: station-plan-choice.js offers initial plan/payment selection only; no current plan end or next start date field
observedProduction.sampleStatus: one QA station subscription trialing; no safely reversible paid switch
observedProduction.financeGate: guarded Production Preview; do not call bank/Stripe, do not write live subscription or invoice while tests blocked

defaultProposal.effectiveInstant: the exact current_period_end instant (end exclusive), not naive midnight in Asia/Bangkok
defaultProposal.customFutureDate: allowed only with explicit old-plan continuation/renewal coverage and consistent payment window; validate date before any write
defaultProposal.immediateMidCycle: defer until explicit proration/credit and consent policy is implemented
defaultProposal.dateFormat: ISO YYYY-MM-DD input; visible localized date plus correct start time
defaultProposal.noDoubleBill: one invoice period claim per station/subscription billing window, immutable issued invoice history
defaultProposal.authorization: station owner only, exact station scope and audited change request
defaultProposal.optimisticConcurrency: subscription version/period-lock, idempotent request ID; duplicate submit returns same outcome
